info.title: IRS Data Book by state: returns filed, gross tax collections and refunds, fiscal years 2019 to 2025: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
IRS Data Book by state: returns filed, gross tax collections and refunds, fiscal years 2019 to 2025: Returns and other forms filed, gross tax collections and refunds issued, from the Internal Revenue Service Data Book state tables, for the nation, each state, DC and Puerto Rico and each fiscal year (October to September) from 2019 to 2025: returns by form type (individual, employment, C corporation, S corporation, partnership), collections by type of tax (individual income and employment, withheld, business income, estate, gift, excise) and the number and amount of refunds. Dollar amounts are in dollars; IRS prints them in thousands. The national record also holds what IRS counts in the nation but assigns to no state.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
